claim: HomeBase must not start its decision ledger with the Axiom Firewall disabled or with an implicit Neo4j credential.

evidence.observation: Startup now trims NEO4J_PASSWORD, rejects it when absent, and terminates before constructing the validator.
The Neo4j client constructor rejects blank credentials before creating a driver or attempting connectivity.
A focused regression test proves whitespace-only credentials fail closed.

root_cause: The prior startup path logged a warning and continued when Neo4j was unavailable, allowing the Axiom Firewall to be disabled; the first isolated fix also omitted the strings import and therefore could not compile.

discriminator.result: The initial promotion failed on undefined strings.TrimSpace; after adding the import, the full HomeBase suite and vet pass.

invariant: HomeBase startup is admitted only when the Axiom Firewall has a non-blank credential and a constructible Neo4j client; missing infrastructure or credentials cannot degrade into an apparently running unprotected ledger.

regression.name: HomeBase firewall startup gate
regression.expected: exit 0; blank credentials are rejected by the client test and the startup path cannot compile or continue with the firewall disabled

gate: Reject promotion if HomeBase can start without Neo4j/Axiom Firewall admission, if the credential is blank, or if the security patch is not covered by a full compile/test/vet pass.
resolution: Made Neo4j mandatory at startup, rejected blank credentials in the client, added the focused test, and corrected the missing strings import exposed by the promotion suite.
